# Face-framing runtime assets

Pinned `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.21 from the npm registry. Module and both SIMD/non-SIMD WebAssembly variants are served locally.

Face Landmarker model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task

Upstream MediaPipe license: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/v0.10.21/LICENSE (included as `LICENSE`).

These are application assets. No user portrait is part of this directory.
